title: cordiera humilis
intro: Cordiera humilis, commonly known as a shrub native to the tropical regions of South America, is a species of plant in the Rubiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cordiera humilis include analgesic, antipyretic, and spasmolytic properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as fever, pain, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Cordiera humilis include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
